name: markdown_table
description: Renders rows as an aligned GitHub-style markdown table (escaping, padding, alignment rules) and parses such tables back.
bugs: column_widths() measures body cells before escaping (str(cell)), so cells containing | or None get the wrong width
_pad() puts the odd leftover space of centred cells on the left instead of the right
_normalize_rows() pads the caller's row lists in place instead of copying them
